meta.source: Defendants' Reply to Plaintiff's Opposition to Motion for Summary Judgment
meta.method: CUARC-compatible: all claims typed as motion assertions

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue Plaintiff fails Rule 1.510 burden
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Plaintiff fails to meet their burden under Fla. R. Civ. P. 1.510. The revised federal-aligned standard requires specific, admissible evidence demonstrating a genuine dispute of material fact.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue Plaintiff relies on improper support
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Misrepresentations of the law and baseless, conclusory statements without any cited support.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue renewed MSJ permitted under Florida law
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Florida law permits renewed summary judgment motions when new legal arguments or evidence are raised.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue prior rulings voidable after recusal
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Fla. R. Jud. Admin. 2.330(h) requires reconsideration of all rulings by a recused judge.
Police Report #2019-00042552 documents Plaintiff's unauthorized removal and disposal of Defendant's property.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue washer/dryer could have been repaired
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: The washer/dryer was under manufacturer warranty—it could have been repaired rather than destroyed.
Under Public Health Trust v. Valcin, 507 So. 2d 596 (Fla. 1987), this mandates an adverse inference.
Plaintiff's allegations rely on nothing more than unpaid estimates for a washer dryer and unsupported invoices for the alleged remediation, offering no proof of actual payment.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants cite Miami Mold subpoenaed records
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Miami Mold's subpoenaed contemporaneous records (Def. Motion Ex. 11), which confirms 'no proof of payment exists.'
Plaintiff fails to establish causation, offering no admissible evidence linking the alleged damages to any act or omission by Defendants.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants argue lack of notice bars recovery
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: This failure is compounded by Plaintiff's lack of required notice, which independently bars recovery under Florida law.

assertions.Definition_or_Context: Defendants seek summary judgment as matter of law
assertions.Evidence_or_Quote: Having failed to provide competent evidence and having destroyed key evidence, Plaintiff cannot avoid summary judgment. As a matter of law, it must be granted.
